protocol: BEIR-style dense-only vs hybrid gate (PLAN.md: nDCG@10 hybrid >= dense-only + 5 points)
graph_channel_note: production run_query adds graph expansion seeded from BM25 hits; the entity graph does not exist for a corpus-agnostic judged set. The gate claim is fusion-over-ranking (dense+BM25 RRF), so the graph channel is excluded from BOTH conditions, stated, not tuned away.
document_text: f'{name} {file_path}' — identical to the production indexing in interface/commands/query.py

scoring.ndcg_gain: graded: gain = 2^grade - 1 (D = Σ gain / log2(i+2), IDCG from ideal grade ordering)
scoring.recall_at_5_relevance: grade >= 2 only (marginal grade-1 docs excluded from the recall denominator)
scoring.metric_source: frozen formula; identical code path scores both conditions

embedding_cache: benchmarks/beir/embedding_cache_<model-safe-name>.json (per-model file, mirroring retrieval/provider cache naming; content-keyed so switching models cannot reuse another model's vectors)

pass_rule.note: established = (nDCG@10_hybrid - nDCG@10_dense) >= +0.05 absolute AND n_queries >= min_queries_to_establish AND validators passed. Otherwise the result is measured-only.

determinism: ranks tie-broken on (-score, docid); both conditions share one embedding pass and the same corpus/query hashes, recorded per run
drift_guards: reject: missing qrels for a query, empty relevance set, duplicate query ids
reject: qrel docid not in corpus, corpus doc text empty
reject: dense and hybrid executed over different corpus/query hashes
reject: different model name between conditions
smoke_disclaimer: benchmarks/retrieval_eval.py (5 queries) remains historical smoke evidence and is NOT this gate's evidence set.
